negative_results.claim_refuted: An in-memory used-confirmation nonce set is sufficient for Harness effect authority.
negative_results.result: False for restart/recovery semantics. Durable confirmation consumption must share an atomic canonical transaction with effect reservation.
negative_results.architecture_effect: Implemented SQLite-backed confirmation_consumptions + effects transaction in H1 reference.

negative_results.claim_refuted: Atomic local confirmation consumption implies exactly-once external effect execution.
negative_results.result: False in the general external-effect case. After an external attempt begins, a crash/timeout can leave outcome unknown; retry is only classified safe when a downstream idempotency contract/key exists, otherwise reconciliation is required.
negative_results.architecture_effect: Added COMMITTING/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and SAFE_TO_RETRY_SAME_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY versus RECONCILE_REQUIRED recovery classes.

negative_results.claim_refuted: Using sqlite3.Connection as a context manager closes read connections.
negative_results.result: The first deep prototype emitted ResourceWarning under warnings-as-errors because the context manager controls transaction completion but does not itself provide the required explicit close behavior for this usage.
negative_results.architecture_effect: Read paths now use explicit contextlib.closing/new connection per operation; 40/40 suite subsequently passed.

negative_results.claim_refuted: Every initially generated item in the 500-case mutation corpus was a true policy mutation.
negative_results.result: One Boolean mutation branch could reproduce the original value and therefore generated a no-op case. The test, not the authority implementation, was wrong.
negative_results.architecture_effect: Mutation corpus repaired to guarantee semantic request-hash changes before asserting rejection.

negative_results.claim_refuted: WAL should be promoted as the obvious H1 effect-lifecycle SQLite mode based on local speed.
negative_results.result: Randomized local DELETE-vs-WAL measurements were mixed and noisy; one WAL run had a very large p99 outlier. No robust backend winner was established.
negative_results.architecture_effect: NO_CHANGE; retain explicit reference configuration and defer backend selection to matched target-VPS correctness/recovery/performance testing.

negative_results.claim_refuted: SQLite PRAGMA integrity_check is sufficient evidence for semantic effect-trace integrity.
negative_results.result: False. A test modified event payload content while SQLite integrity_check remained ok; independent event-hash verification detected the semantic tamper.
negative_results.architecture_effect: Keep physical database integrity and semantic event/trace integrity as separate mandatory checks.

epistemic_note: These results are H1 local implementation/falsification evidence. They do not promote production, target-VPS, distributed exactly-once, or broad security claims.
